name: AppSpace
author: Dominik Zajac
description: Where apps open, how your monitors are laid out, and workspaces per monitor on Omarchy 4.5: assign workspaces to screens, drag screens into place with a keep-or-revert safety net, and show each monitor's own workspaces in the bar.
